plugins.name: issuekit
plugins.description: Shared adapter layer for issue-tracker plugins. Auto-detects the active MCP (Azure DevOps, Jira) and exposes an abstract verb surface (getIssue, addComment, transition, linkIssue, ...). Auto-installed as a dependency of incident-postmortem and issue-triage. Bring your own MCPs; no .mcp.json bundled.

plugins.name: incident-postmortem
plugins.description: End-to-end incident postmortem generator. Paste an incident URL (Azure DevOps or Jira); the agent gathers evidence, builds a timeline, and writes a Google-SRE-style blameless postmortem. Auto-installs issuekit; bring your own MCPs.

plugins.name: issue-triage
plugins.description: End-to-end issue triage across all archetypes (Bug, Incident, Story, Feature, Task, Spike) on any supported tracker (Azure DevOps, Jira). All writes pass through a single diff-and-confirm gate. Auto-installs issuekit; bring your own MCPs.

plugins.name: testid-injector
plugins.description: Adds missing data-testid attributes to web UI source. Scans React/JSX/TSX (auto-detects plain HTML, Vue, Angular), finds every form control, dropdown, dropdown option, link, and interactive element without a test id, and writes stable semantic kebab-case ids. Idempotent and gated by a single diff-and-confirm step. Configurable via .claude/testid-policy.json. No MCPs required.
